// diagnostic

E0996

`members:` evaluated to something other than a list of strings.

What

`members:` evaluated to something other than a list of strings.

Why

The `members:` value must evaluate to `[String]` — a list of relative package directory paths.

Fix

use `find("./packages")` or a list literal like `["./packages/hello", "./packages/ranker"]`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0996: tests/ui/workspace_e0996.stderr.

Error [E0996]: `members:` must evaluate to a list of package paths

    |                             ^^
 Why: the `members:` value must evaluate to a `[String]` — a list of relative package directory paths
 Fix: example: `members: find("./packages")` or `members: ["./pkg/hello"]`
